items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1969-12-04
items.q: Who did I take from? Fabian. From Farley and Fabian. And how did he teach you? ... He taught me from the Auburn method

ctx.x: Pardon? P-A-U-L-I-N. F-A-B-I-A-N. Fabian. Fabian. I made my first professional engagement when I was 12, standing on the Coca-Cola box, playing at a mass meeting, political meeting. I got eight dollars. I was a rich man that night.
Since we're mentioning dates, if you're eight years old, do you know your brother's birthday? Yes.
